scenes.caption: AI Done Right — two products on one governed engine
scenes.narration: AI Done Right is a holding company over two products that share one governed engine, plus an open store of components both consume.

scenes.caption: Baltor governs TRUTH · Teleon governs EFFICIENCY
scenes.narration: Baltor is fully managed governed context — company, department, or initiative wide. Teleon lets you program a capability in plain text and it adapts to the cheapest bounded form within your guardrails.

scenes.caption: Live: capabilities descend unbounded → bounded
scenes.narration: Here are three capabilities running live — document extraction, search enrichment, and model routing — each descending from the expensive default to the cheapest bounded path that still meets the requirement.

scenes.caption: Efficiency climbs, safety holds in control
scenes.narration: The control chart proves the point: efficiency climbs while safety stays pinned at the ceiling. We never trade a correct or grounded answer for a cheaper one.

scenes.caption: Two products + the open store, by the dependency law
scenes.narration: The architecture, top to bottom by the enforced dependency law: Baltor, then Teleon, then the open store of components — context, tools, models, reconciliation, robustness, and enrichment rules.

scenes.caption: The proof is real — OFAC live receipt, 553 green proofs
scenes.narration: And it is real today: a live OFAC sanctions receipt, a working offline engine, and hundreds of deterministic proofs. That is the ask.
